WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::text AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "purchased_at"
FROM TMP
JOIN "parity_marketplace"."purchases"
  ON "store_code" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "purchased_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "purchased_at" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "purchased_at", "purchase_id"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::text AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "store_code", "region",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY CAST("region" AS text), CAST("store_code" AS text)) AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "parity_marketplace"."stores"
    ON "store_code" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::text AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "purchase_id", "customer_id", "item_id", "amount", "purchased_at", "store_code",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "purchased_at" DESC, "purchase_id", "amount", "customer_id", "item_id", CAST("store_code" AS text)) AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "parity_marketplace"."purchases"
  WHERE "store_code" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "purchased_at" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "purchased_at" DESC, "purchase_id", "amount", "customer_id", "item_id", CAST("store_code" AS text)
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__
